title: Catchplate native credential recipient evidence v1
description: Original native recipient evidence only. Schema conformance does not verify Nitro attestation or admit the recipient key.

attestationDocumentB64.description: Original Nitro attestation document encoded as unpadded URL-safe base64; decoding, canonical encoding and the 12288-byte decoded limit are checked at runtime.

recipientPublicKey.description: The raw 32-byte X25519 recipient public key, not DER, in canonical unpadded URL-safe base64. Runtime verification checks the actual key and its attestation binding.
